mapper.sql: id, binding_id, platform, platform_user_id, user_id, display_name, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_channel_identity ( binding_id, platform, platform_user_id, user_id, display_name, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{bindingId}, #{platform}, #{platformUserId}, #{userId}, #{displayName}, #{firstSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_channel_identity SET display_name = IFNULL(#{displayName}, display_name), last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
